connector.name: Agent Gate by forgeorbital.com
connector.registryDescription: Local mandate gate and proof trail for AI agents that take consequential actions.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package forge-agent-gate. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.forgeorbital, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FORGE_API_KEY
env.description: Forge decision-API key (starts with fi_). Set this or FORGE_BEARER_TOKEN.

env.name: FORGE_BEARER_TOKEN
env.description: Alternative to FORGE_API_KEY: a Forge bearer token for the decision API.

env.name: FORGE_API_BASE_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Forge decision API. Defaults to the hosted Forge cloud.

env.name: FORGE_TENANT_ID
env.description: Tenant id stamped into every proof-trail record.

env.name: FORGE_RECORD_MODE
env.description: required = fail-closed (block if Forge cannot record); best_effort = execute anyway.

env.name: AGENT_GATE_MANDATE_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to the signed mandate (policy) JSON. Create it with `forge-agent-gate init`.

env.name: AGENT_GATE_KILL_FILE
env.description: If this file exists, every gated write is hard-blocked (master kill switch).

env.name: KALSHI_API_KEY_ID
env.description: Kalshi API key id. Only for the live Kalshi venue adapter; stays on your machine.

env.name: KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
env.description: Path to your Kalshi RSA private key. Only for the Kalshi venue adapter.

env.name: KALSHI_ENV
env.description: Kalshi environment: demo or prod. Only for the Kalshi venue adapter.
